name: Standing Order 11
definition: Defines the detailed attributes of a standing order.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money and currency to be transferred when a payment instruction is created as a result of a standing order.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies if the account is debited or credited by the standing order.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for a standing order, as assigned by the account servicer or the account owner.

AssociatedPoolAccount.name: Associated Pool Account
AssociatedPoolAccount.definition: Liquidity transfer origin or destination account within the pool of accounts under management of the requestor.

Reference.name: Reference
Reference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for a standing order, as assigned by the account servicer or the account owner.

Frequency.name: Frequency
Frequency.definition: Regularity with which payment instructions are to be created and processed as a result of the standing order, such as daily, weekly, or monthly.

ValidityPeriod.name: Validity Period
ValidityPeriod.definition: Dates during which the standing order is in effect.

SystemMember.name: System Member
SystemMember.definition: Specifies if the account is debited or credited by the standing order.

ResponsibleParty.name: Responsible Party
ResponsibleParty.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

LinkSetIdentification.name: Link Set Identification
LinkSetIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the link set in which the standing order is defined. The link set is a collection of standing order defined in a specific sequence.

LinkSetOrderIdentification.name: Link Set Order Identification
LinkSetOrderIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify liquidity transfer standing order within the link set.

LinkSetOrderSequence.name: Link Set Order Sequence
LinkSetOrderSequence.definition: Specifies the sequence in which the system will execute the liquidity transfers standing order within the link set when additional liquidity is required.

ExecutionType.name: Execution Type
ExecutionType.definition: Defines whether the standing order is executed through a time-based or an event-based trigger.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Party to which an amount of money is due.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Cash account credited from a standing order mechanism.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.definition: Party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.

DebtorAccount.name: Debtor Account
DebtorAccount.definition: Cash account debited from a standing order mechanism.

TotalsPerStandingOrder.name: Totals Per Standing Order
TotalsPerStandingOrder.definition: Overall amount of "not yet executed" predefined liquidity transfer orders or "defined" by a system participant in its sphere of responsibility within the system.

ZeroSweepIndicator.name: Zero Sweep Indicator
ZeroSweepIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the liquidity transfer standing order is defined as a zero sweeping order. When true, the liquidity transfer standing order will transfer all amount of money out of the account so the resulting balance is zero.
